description: This file contains helper functions for generating and handling ASN.1 encoded XNAP setup request, response, and failure messages, as well as converting cause types within the ocudu::ocucp namespace.

methods.name: generate_asn1_xn_setup_request
methods.description: Generates an ASN.1 encoded XNAP setup request message based on provided configuration.

methods.name: generate_asn1_xn_setup_response
methods.description: Generates an ASN.1 encoded XNAP setup response message based on provided configuration.

methods.name: cause_to_asn1
methods.description: Converts a xnap_cause_t type to ASN.1 cause representation.

methods.name: generate_asn1_xn_setup_failure
methods.description: Generates an ASN.1 encoded XNAP setup failure message with cause and optional time to wait.
